sentences.text: Purpose.
sentences.say: Purpose.

sentences.text: Most agent projects fail by being too complicated, too early.
sentences.say: Most agent projects fail by being too complicated, too early.

sentences.text: This chapter turns Anthropic's advice into a practical method: decide whether you need an agent at all, build the smallest version, put every safety rule in code, and learn to read what the agent sees.
sentences.say: This chapter turns Anthropic's advice into a practical method: decide whether you need an agent at all, build the smallest version, put every safety rule in code, and learn to read what the agent sees.

sentences.text: It ends with the tool-use loop you will write by hand in week 3.
sentences.say: It ends with the tool-use loop you will write by hand in week 3.

sentences.text: Key ideas
sentences.say: Key ideas

sentences.text: Do not build an agent for everything.
sentences.say: Do not build an agent for everything.

sentences.text: Check the task against four questions first.
sentences.say: Check the task against four questions first.

sentences.text: An agent is a model using tools in a loop.
sentences.say: An agent is a model using tools in a loop.

sentences.text: It has three parts: environment, tools, system prompt.
sentences.say: It has three parts: environment, tools, system prompt.

sentences.text: Iterate on those before anything fancy.
sentences.say: Iterate on those before anything fancy.

sentences.text: Safety rules belong in code, not in the prompt: a prompt can be talked around, a read-only connection cannot.
sentences.say: Safety rules belong in code, not in the prompt: a prompt can be talked around, a read-only connection cannot.

sentences.text: Put yourself in the agent's context window.
sentences.say: Put yourself in the agent's context window.

sentences.text: If you could not do the task with only what it sees, neither can it.
sentences.say: If you could not do the task with only what it sees, neither can it.

sentences.text: Measure every change on a fixed set of gold questions.
sentences.say: Measure every change on a fixed set of gold questions.

sentences.text: 17.1 Do you need an agent?
sentences.say: 17.1 Do you need an agent?

sentences.text: Barry Zhang (Anthropic) offers a checklist.
sentences.say: Barry Zhang (Anthropic) offers a checklist.

sentences.text: Agents suit complex, valuable tasks, and cost, latency and the price of mistakes all rise with agency:
sentences.say: Agents suit complex, valuable tasks, and cost, latency and the price of mistakes all rise with agency:

sentences.text: Coding passes the checklist: the task is ambiguous, good code is valuable, Claude is already good at it, and unit tests and continuous integration verify the output.
sentences.say: Coding passes the checklist: the task is ambiguous, good code is valuable, Claude is already good at it, and unit tests and continuous integration verify the output.

sentences.text: That is why so many coding agents succeed.
sentences.say: That is why so many coding agents succeed.

sentences.text: 17.2 Keep it simple: three parts
sentences.say: 17.2 Keep it simple: three parts

sentences.text: Barry Zhang's definition: an agent is a model using tools in a loop.
sentences.say: Barry Zhang's definition: an agent is a model using tools in a loop.

sentences.text: Three parts define it:
sentences.say: Three parts define it:

sentences.text: The environment: the system the agent works in (for you, the SQLite database of loans).
sentences.say: The environment: the system the agent works in (for you, the SQLite database of loans).

sentences.text: The tools: the interface through which it acts and gets feedback (run_sql).
sentences.say: The tools: the interface through which it acts and gets feedback (run sql).

sentences.text: The system prompt: the goals, constraints and ideal behaviour.
sentences.say: The system prompt: the goals, constraints and ideal behaviour.

sentences.text: The three agent products he shows look very different on the surface, yet share almost exactly the same code.
sentences.say: The three agent products he shows look very different on the surface, yet share almost exactly the same code.

sentences.text: Complexity up front kills iteration speed, so first iterate on these three parts only.
sentences.say: Complexity up front kills iteration speed, so first iterate on these three parts only.

sentences.text: Optimize afterwards: cache the trajectory for coding and computer use, run tool calls in parallel for search, and show progress to build trust.
sentences.say: Optimize afterwards: cache the trajectory for coding and computer use, run tool calls in parallel for search, and show progress to build trust.

sentences.text: 17.3 The tool-use loop, step by step
sentences.say: 17.3 The tool-use loop, step by step

sentences.text: The model never runs your tool.
sentences.say: The model never runs your tool.

sentences.text: It asks for it, and your code runs it (Anthropic's Handle tool calls page):
sentences.say: It asks for it, and your code runs it (Anthropic's Handle tool calls page):

sentences.text: You send the question, the system prompt and the list of tools (name, description, input schema).
sentences.say: You send the question, the system prompt and the list of tools (name, description, input schema).

sentences.text: The reply has stop_reason equal to tool_use, and one or more tool_use blocks, each with an id, a name and an input.
sentences.say: The reply has stop reason equal to tool use, and one or more tool use blocks, each with an id, a name and an input.

sentences.text: Your code runs each tool.
sentences.say: Your code runs each tool.

sentences.text: You send a new user message that holds a tool_result block for each call, with the matching tool_use_id, the output as content, and is_error set to true if it failed.
sentences.say: You send a new user message that holds a tool result block for each call, with the matching tool use id, the output as content, and is error set to true if it failed.

sentences.text: The tool_result blocks must come first in that message, before any text.
sentences.say: The tool result blocks must come first in that message, before any text.

sentences.text: Repeat until the reply has a different stop_reason, which means the model has answered.
sentences.say: Repeat until the reply has a different stop reason, which means the model has answered.

sentences.text: Always limit the number of turns.
sentences.say: Always limit the number of turns.

sentences.text: The door the model goes through.
sentences.say: The door the model goes through.

sentences.text: Every rule is enforced in code.
sentences.say: Every rule is enforced in code.

sentences.text: This tested sketch allows one SELECT on known tables, adds a row limit and uses a read-only connection, so a bad query cannot change anything even if the checks missed it:
sentences.say: This tested sketch allows one SELECT on known tables, adds a row limit and uses a read-only connection, so a bad query cannot change anything even if the checks missed it:

sentences.text: On a small test database I ran: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications returned [(3,)]; DELETE FROM offers gave "Refused: only a single SELECT statement is allowed"; SELECT * FROM customers gave "Refused: unknown tables ['customers']"; SELECT 1; DROP TABLE offers was refused too; and a wrong column name returned "SQL error: no such column".
sentences.say: On a small test database I ran: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications returned (3,); DELETE FROM offers gave "Refused: only a single SELECT statement is allowed"; SELECT * FROM customers gave "Refused: unknown tables 'customers'"; SELECT 1; DROP TABLE offers was refused too; and a wrong column name returned "SQL error: no such column".

sentences.text: This simple version also refuses queries that start with WITH (common table expressions), because the temporary names count as unknown tables; extend it if you need them.
sentences.say: This simple version also refuses queries that start with WITH (common table expressions), because the temporary names count as unknown tables; extend it if you need them.

sentences.text: Note that the refusal messages are written for the model: a clear message is how it learns to fix its next query.
sentences.say: Note that the refusal messages are written for the model: a clear message is how it learns to fix its next query.

sentences.text: The loop.
sentences.say: The loop.

sentences.text: A sketch of the loop with the Anthropic SDK.
sentences.say: A sketch of the loop with the Anthropic SDK.

sentences.text: I have not run this one against the API, because it needs your key and spends money: write your own first, then compare with this and with the docs.
sentences.say: I have not run this one against the API, because it needs your key and spends money: write your own first, then compare with this and with the docs.

sentences.text: 17.4 Designing tools the model can use
sentences.say: 17.4 Designing tools the model can use

sentences.text: Beyond the videos.
sentences.say: Beyond the videos.

sentences.text: The model only knows a tool through its name, description and schema, so write them as if for a new colleague who cannot ask questions:
sentences.say: The model only knows a tool through its name, description and schema, so write them as if for a new colleague who cannot ask questions:

sentences.text: A clear verb name (run_sql), a one-sentence description of what it does and does not do, and parameter descriptions with an example value.
sentences.say: A clear verb name (run sql), a one-sentence description of what it does and does not do, and parameter descriptions with an example value.

sentences.text: Few tools, each doing one thing.
sentences.say: Few tools, each doing one thing.

sentences.text: Ten overlapping tools confuse the model.
sentences.say: Ten overlapping tools confuse the model.

sentences.text: Return what the model needs, not everything: a limited number of rows, with the column names.
sentences.say: Return what the model needs, not everything: a limited number of rows, with the column names.

sentences.text: Make failures instructive: "unknown table, allowed tables are ..." beats "error".
sentences.say: Make failures instructive: "unknown table, allowed tables are ..." beats "error".

sentences.text: The model's input is untrusted.
sentences.say: The model's input is untrusted.

sentences.text: Validate it in code like any user input, and never give a tool more power than the task needs (least privilege).
sentences.say: Validate it in code like any user input, and never give a tool more power than the task needs (least privilege).

sentences.text: 17.5 Think like your agent
sentences.say: 17.5 Think like your agent

sentences.text: At every step the model sees only its context window, perhaps 10 to 20 thousand tokens: the system prompt, the conversation and the tool results so far.
sentences.say: At every step the model sees only its context window, perhaps 10 to 20 thousand tokens: the system prompt, the conversation and the tool results so far.

sentences.text: Barry Zhang's exercise: imagine you are a computer-use agent that gets one screenshot and a poorly written description, clicks, and then is blind for three to five seconds before the next screenshot.
sentences.say: Barry Zhang's exercise: imagine you are a computer-use agent that gets one screenshot and a poorly written description, clicks, and then is blind for three to five seconds before the next screenshot.

sentences.text: You would want to know the screen resolution, which actions are allowed and what to avoid.
sentences.say: You would want to know the screen resolution, which actions are allowed and what to avoid.

sentences.text: Do the same for your agent: read a full trajectory and ask whether you could have done the task with only that information.
sentences.say: Do the same for your agent: read a full trajectory and ask whether you could have done the task with only that information.

sentences.text: Then ask the model itself.
sentences.say: Then ask the model itself.

sentences.text: Paste in the system prompt and ask "is any of this ambiguous?"
sentences.say: Paste in the system prompt and ask "is any of this ambiguous?"

sentences.text: Paste in a tool description and ask whether it knows how to use it.
sentences.say: Paste in a tool description and ask whether it knows how to use it.

sentences.text: Paste in a whole trajectory and ask "why did you make this decision here, and what would help you decide better?"
sentences.say: Paste in a whole trajectory and ask "why did you make this decision here, and what would help you decide better?"

sentences.text: It does not replace your own reading, but it shows how the agent sees the world.
sentences.say: It does not replace your own reading, but it shows how the agent sees the world.

sentences.text: 17.6 Evaluating an agent
sentences.say: 17.6 Evaluating an agent

sentences.text: The rules from Chapter 12 apply.
sentences.say: The rules from Chapter 12 apply.

sentences.text: Write gold questions with their gold answers by hand: for the SQL agent, a question and the SQL a loan officer would write.
sentences.say: Write gold questions with their gold answers by hand: for the SQL agent, a question and the SQL a loan officer would write.

sentences.text: Score execution accuracy: does the model's query return the same rows as the gold query?
sentences.say: Score execution accuracy: does the model's query return the same rows as the gold query?

sentences.text: Keep notes on every failure (wrong table, wrong join, misread date), since the failure notes tell you what to fix.
sentences.say: Keep notes on every failure (wrong table, wrong join, misread date), since the failure notes tell you what to fix.

sentences.text: Check the safety property with its own test: "delete all cancelled applications" must be refused by the code, and the eval should prove it.
sentences.say: Check the safety property with its own test: "delete all cancelled applications" must be refused by the code, and the eval should prove it.

sentences.text: Change one thing at a time and re-run the same questions.
sentences.say: Change one thing at a time and re-run the same questions.

sentences.text: 17.7 Open questions
sentences.say: 17.7 Open questions

sentences.text: Barry Zhang's list of unsolved problems: agents that respect a budget (time, money, tokens), as workflows already do; tools that improve themselves; and several agents working together, where sub-agents protect the main agent's context window but nobody has settled how they should talk to each other asynchronously.
sentences.say: Barry Zhang's list of unsolved problems: agents that respect a budget (time, money, tokens), as workflows already do; tools that improve themselves; and several agents working together, where sub-agents protect the main agent's context window but nobody has settled how they should talk to each other asynchronously.

sentences.text: Expect these to change.
sentences.say: Expect these to change.

sentences.text: Loan example.
sentences.say: Loan example.

sentences.text: The question "What share of applications in 2016 were cancelled?" needs a date filter, a status column and a division.
sentences.say: The question "What share of applications in 2016 were cancelled?" needs a date filter, a status column and a division.

sentences.text: The agent writes the SQL, run_sql refuses or runs it, the result comes back, and the model phrases the answer.
sentences.say: The agent writes the SQL, run sql refuses or runs it, the result comes back, and the model phrases the answer.

sentences.text: Every step is in the trajectory, so a wrong answer can be traced to the exact query.
sentences.say: Every step is in the trajectory, so a wrong answer can be traced to the exact query.

sentences.text: Common mistakes
sentences.say: Common mistakes

sentences.text: Starting with a framework before you understand the loop.
sentences.say: Starting with a framework before you understand the loop.

sentences.text: Putting "never delete data" in the prompt instead of enforcing it in code.
sentences.say: Putting "never delete data" in the prompt instead of enforcing it in code.

sentences.text: No turn limit, no logging, no budget.
sentences.say: No turn limit, no logging, no budget.

sentences.text: Changing the prompt and the tools at the same time, then not knowing which helped.
sentences.say: Changing the prompt and the tools at the same time, then not knowing which helped.

sentences.text: Judging the agent by a few demo questions instead of a fixed gold set.
sentences.say: Judging the agent by a few demo questions instead of a fixed gold set.
